findings: The change history dates introduction of the dedicated paragraph-start marker <%> to version1.6, 21 November2019.
Table7 gives @, + and * relative-layout meanings. None is specified as a paragraph-start assertion.
The <$> dedicated comment denotes paragraph end. The later <%> marker denotes paragraph start. Drawing interruption remains distinct.
sources.applicability_limit: This is a historical specification with a 1.5-to-1.7 change history, not a byte-identical version1.5 manual. It cannot independently certify every detail of the beta1.5 conversion.
